concepts.gloss_en: Tefillin as mochin — the explicit identification that the tefillin ARE the intellects/brain-lights, whereby the 'angel' is made
Mochin — the intellects/mentalities themselves (their rectification via breaking lust; the brain as a burning candle fed by bodily moisture)

reason_for_human: Only occ 3326 actually pairs the two words — 'עַל־יְדֵי תְּפִלִּין מֹחִין נַעֲשֶׂה בְּחִינַת הַמַּלְאָךְ' (tefillin=mochin makes the angel). Occ 3517's paragraph (5_7_1) contains NO tefillin at all — it is entirely about rectifying the mochin (brain as candle, bodily moisture) — so tagging it 'תפלין מחין' is spurious; that occurrence is plain מחין. Under-merge: kept the true tefillin-mochin node separate from the bare mochin usage.
